name: Julee Brooks
office: William S. Hart Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Brooks says she is the chief executive officer of a community-based educational organization that provides afterschool, summer, and outdoor education programs to 30,000 students annually in Southern California.

sentences.text: Brooks says she is the chief executive officer of a community-based educational organization that provides afterschool, summer, and outdoor education programs to 30,000 students annually in Southern California.

items.text: At an October 2026 candidate forum, Brooks said her priorities include student safety, mental health supports, and extracurricular activities that give young people places to belong. She said she would work to ensure parity in educational opportunities and academic success across the district. She stressed the importance of parent-teacher partnerships and praised the district's communication when problems arise.
